import numpy as np

A = np.array([[1, 2, 3],
              [0, 1, 4],
              [5, 6, 0]])

det_A = np.linalg.det(A)

B = np.array([[1, 0, 2, -1],
              [3, 1, 0, 2],
              [0, 2, 1, 0],
              [1, -1, 0, 1]])

det_B = np.linalg.det(B)

is_invertible = abs(det_A) > 1e-10

det_product = np.linalg.det(A @ A.T)

C = np.array([[2, 0, 1],
              [1, 3, 0],
              [0, 1, 2]])

det_AC = np.linalg.det(A @ C)
det_A_times_det_C = det_A * np.linalg.det(C)

print(f"det(A) = {det_A}")
print(f"det(B) = {det_B}")
print(f"A is invertible: {is_invertible}")
print(f"det(A @ A.T) = {det_product}")
print(f"det(A @ C) = {det_AC}")
print(f"det(A) * det(C) = {det_A_times_det_C}")
